content: ArchWiki NetworkManager (verified): NetworkManager owns Wi-Fi/wired/modem/VPN; CLI nmcli + nmtui; GUI = nm-connection-editor (profiles incl. IPv4/IPv6 DNS, static routes, proxy, VPN) and network-manager-applet (nm-applet) tray. Secrets stored in profiles readable via GUI. Implication: DNS/proxy/VPN config should delegate to NM profiles (D-Bus NM.Settings/secret-agent), not flat files; systemd-resolved integration is the DNS handoff point.
